stop_policy: Forward observed INT/TERM/HUP to the known separate child group; stop admission of later slots. Controller error, explicit stop or cap violation kills only its known still-running child group with SIGKILL and performs actual Popen.wait, without a numerical timeout or grace-period retry. Unexpected surviving descendants are killed and reported as unknown work; they are never treated as observed normal exits.
caps_limitations: Admission reserves available-memory/disk headroom before each child, and the child sets a per-file RLIMIT_FSIZE before imports. These are not a hard RSS or whole-filesystem guarantee. Live group RSS and output sizes are sampled; overshoots can occur between samples and are retained as failures. Worker Linux ru_maxrss is checked after its actual return. Compiler/cache files outside the retained output tree are not included in output byte totals; full process costs and cache warmth remain disclosed. No fair-speed claim.
